text:
alex_infra: Heads up — vendor just sent allocation update for the GPU batch we ordered (PO 8923-RED). They can release 48 units next week, remainder ~72 units in 10–12 weeks. Pricing unchanged but expedited shipping option available at +9%. :thinking:

simon_vendor: confirmed. we can split shipment — 48 immediate (US west coast warehouse), 72 backordered. expedited air gives ~2–3 week ETA for second tranche but costs go up. can quote ground+priority lanes. will attach AWB & manifest when booked.

maria_ops: Are the immediate 48 units all the same SKU/firmware? we need specific firmware builds for our runtime compatibility (v3.2 with ECC patch). also any customs documentation for EU/UK if we route later?

simon_vendor: all 48 are A40-32Q (fw v3.2.1). For EU we’ll include CN22 and commercial invoice; for UK we’ll add EORI line item if you give us company EORI.

rma_bot: RMA reminder — open cases require serial numbers + failure descriptions before vendor will issue prepaid labels. Use /rma create to generate the return packet and get an RMA ID.

alex_infra: We’ll be pulling 10 failed units out of prod cluster us-west-1 today. planning to decommission nodes, snapshot KV cache, and hot-swap. Can vendor arrange same-day pickup for those 10 when labels ready?

simon_vendor: we can do courier pickup for <=10 units same-day if labels and RMA IDs are provided by 1600 PT. Otherwise next-business-day. Also note: RMAs for damaged boards may need depot inspection which adds ~5 business days.

taylor_prod: Re: capacity — can we carve capacity from ai-batch to cover the shortfall if shipments slip? we have some spare pods but they'd need a config flip and rollback plan. I can schedule a canary for tonight if approved.

maria_ops: I'd rather avoid flipping production. Cost check: expedited air for 72 units at +9% equals roughly $115k extra. Is that cheaper than losing 2 weeks of dedicated throughput on customer clusters? rough calc: ~ $200k revenue at risk per week for affected customers.

alex_infra: Agree with maria. For high-priority customers we should expedite. For the remainder we accept ground. Simon — can you provide per-unit expedited surcharge and detailed lead time risks (customs, manifest hold probabilities)?

simon_vendor: will send a formal addendum by EOD with: per-unit expedite fee, AWB examples, estimated customs duty ranges per region, and the backorder scheduling window. also include RMA flow for returns: 1) you create RMA, 2) we provide prepaid label, 3) courier pickup, 4) depot inspection (if flagged), 5) repair/replacement.

rma_bot: Quick reminder — please include node hostname + serials in the RMA form (format: hostname | serial | issue). Missing serials delay pickup.

alex_infra: Copy. I’ll paste a csv in thread later with 10 serials. Also: we need the vendor to accept our swap policy — we’ll keep 48 loaners for 30 days to avoid downtime during transit. is that acceptable?

simon_vendor: we can provide a temporary swap pool for up to 30 days on credit terms. need PO amendment to include loaner clause.

maria_ops: OK proceed with loaners for top 20 customers only. Alex, coordinate which 20 to prioritize and add to the PO amendment request.

taylor_prod: I’ll prep the rollback playbook and a short runbook for support (how to evict pods, reattach cache, validate perf). should be <30 min per node after hot-swap.

alex_infra: Uploaded CSV with 10 serials and hostnames in thread. (see below)

simon_vendor: got the CSV. opening RMAs now — RMA IDs: RMA-78321 through RMA-78330. Creating courier labels, ETA pickup today 15:30 PT. AWB: 1Z999AA10123456784 (sample). Sending actual labels via email and in this thread in 5m. :ship:

maria_ops: Please cc customs@redwood on the manifest. Also confirm insured value on the AWB (need to match commercial invoice).

simon_vendor: will cc customs. insured value matches invoice unless you ask otherwise.

rma_bot: STATUS UPDATE: pickup scheduled 15:30 PT. RMAs RMA-78321..RMA-78330 labelled.

alex_infra: Thanks team. Action items: simon to send formal expedite quote + PO amendment, provide AWBs and labels; alex to decommission nodes and hand off loaner list; taylor to prepare rollback/runbook; maria to confirm finance sign-off if expedite required.

simon_vendor: will follow up with docs + amendment by EOD.

maria_ops: Approved for expedited for the 20 high-priority customers pending final quote. :white_check_mark:
